cases.limits: The document declares one root requirement, ApiKeyAuth, as http bearer, so no security override is needed; the body already sets additionalProperties false, so no --closed override is needed. A request with only name is a restricted subset, not a vector-store effect guarantee.

findings.text: The CLI does not define how --closed names the root body object. body is used here as a provisional spelling; the mapper must reject an ambiguous alias rather than guess between it and an absolute JSON pointer.

Mapping minLength (characters) to min_bytes (UTF-8 bytes) admits multibyte strings with fewer characters than the vendor minimum when minLength is greater than 1. No case here exercises it: Todoist content has minLength 1, which maps exactly.

OpenAPI 3.1 documents such as Todoist spell nullable as anyOf [T, {type: null}]. The mapping table recognizes nullable: true and type: [T, "null"], and reads other anyOf as rejected without override. Every such field in this corpus is optional and omitted, but requiring one would have no override path under a literal reading.

The recipe compiler on main accepts only an https origin whose path is exactly / and that does not end in a slash. OpenAI's server https://api.openai.com/v1 must become origin https://api.openai.com plus a fixed v1 path segment, and Todoist's https://api.todoist.com/ must drop its trailing slash. The request-mapping table says only that servers become the operator-pinned origin.

The recipe compiler on main requires the profile to carry operator_namespace (single-variant enum), operation_id (string with min_bytes at least 1 and max_bytes at most 128), and recipe_digest (string, exactly 64 bytes). The argument-mapping table maps only the JSON body and path parameters, so derivation must add these fields or recipe check will reject every candidate here.

No candidate was written as profile.toml and recipe.toml or run through the recipe compiler. Slice sizes and $ref counts above were measured; derivation, compilation, and provider behavior were not checked.
